comparison.objective: Roll a wide drum up a ramp onto a deck until it rests against a stop bar.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-body/bimanual nonprehensile rolling of a heavy object, not millimetre-scale tool alignment and fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Drum reaches the deck stop and arms clear; the body notes even one arm can succeed and gives no force/damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: The manipulation scale, contact mode, and goal state differ fundamentally.
